usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), Comoros
usdRate.note: 2025 average. The Comorian franc is fixed at 491.96775 per euro (BCC), so the dollar rate moves with the euro.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of the Comoros (BCC), Monetary Policy Committee communiqué of 8 October 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 1.6% year on year in the second quarter of 2026; the BCC expects 1.8% for 2026 after 3.3% in 2025.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCC: 3.3% inflation in 2025, 1.8% expected for 2026; franc fixed to the euro
inflation_projection.note: The franc is fixed to the euro, which anchors inflation near euro-area levels, but food and fuel shocks pushed it far higher in 2022-2023, so a rounded 3% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCC Monetary Policy Committee communiqué of 8 October 2026 (TSAO)
policy_rate.note: Maximum rate on the BCC liquidity tenders (TSAO) kept at 2.5% on 8 October 2026 (marginal lending facility 5.5%, reserve requirement 10%).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: BCC, Taux d'intérêt de la BCC (minimum rate on savings deposits)
savings_account_rate.note: Minimum rate banks must pay on savings deposits, 2.5% since 1 August 2022 (was 1.75%); the BCC page was last updated in August 2023 (older than 2025) and no later change was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate was found on the BCC site or in its quarterly bulletin.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate was found on the BCC site or in its quarterly bulletin.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Comoros
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2.06% in 2022, the latest World Bank value (older than 2025); the BCC raised the minimum savings rate from 1.75% to 2.5% in August 2022.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The Treasury issues only 28-day bills through BCC auctions (weighted average rate 4.73% on 31 August 2026); no 91-day bill or yield exists.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No domestic government bond market or 5-year yield was found; the Treasury issues only short-term bills.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No domestic government bond market or 10-year yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax rate on bank interest for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries has no Comoros page.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and no rule on its taxation was found.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit guarantee scheme or cover limit was found on the BCC site or in its quarterly bulletin.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BCC, Taux d'intérêt de la BCC (range of lending rates, interest and fees)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Bank lending rates, interest and fees included, must lie between 2.5% and 14% a year since 1 August 2022; the 14% ceiling applies to all bank credit, cards included. The page dates from August 2023 (older than 2025).

equity_return_low.sourceName: No stock exchange in the Comoros; franc fixed to the euro (491.96775 per euro, BCC)
equity_return_low.note: No local stock market exists, so equity means a global index in euro terms (equal to franc terms under the peg); low case is a weak decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No stock exchange in the Comoros; franc fixed to the euro (491.96775 per euro, BCC)
equity_return_base.note: Global equities in euro terms, held to about 3.5 points above the 2.5% minimum savings rate, since access is only through foreign funds.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No stock exchange in the Comoros; franc fixed to the euro (491.96775 per euro, BCC)
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities repeat their long-run euro-terms record.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Franc fixed at 491.96775 per euro (BCC); gold trend in euro terms
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold prices with no currency loss under the euro peg.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Franc fixed at 491.96775 per euro (BCC); gold trend in euro terms
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run gold trend of about 4-5% a year in euro terms, which the franc follows.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Franc fixed at 491.96775 per euro (BCC); gold trend in euro terms

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCC minimum savings rate 2.5%; 28-day Treasury bills at 4.73% (banks only)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits at or below the 2.5% minimum after any tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCC minimum savings rate 2.5%; 28-day Treasury bills at 4.73% (banks only)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: savings and term deposits at about the 2.5% minimum; Treasury bills are sold only to banks.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BCC minimum savings rate 2.5%; 28-day Treasury bills at 4.73% (banks only)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits nearer the 4.73% Treasury bill rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claim settlement ratio was found; the Comoros is not a CIMA member and no national insurance supervisor publication was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates per KMF 1,000 of cover were found; the life insurance market is very small.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Comoros
oop_health_share.note: 56.6% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Inflation assumption 3%; no medical CPI found
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical price index was found; medical costs, much of them imported or paid abroad, are planned 1.5 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Inflation assumption 3%; no education CPI found
goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index was found; private school costs are planned 1 point above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Comoros
life_expectancy.note: 67.0 years in 2024 (men 65.0, women 69.2); latest World Bank value, older than 2025.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals are the mean of men and women except at 65, where the page gives 13.2 for both sexes.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.59 (2025, World Bank), 8.3 (2040, populationpyramid.net/comoros/2040/) and 12.8 (2065, populationpyramid.net/comoros/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The pension age for private-sector workers could not be confirmed from an official source; no official site of a Comorian social security or pension fund was reachable.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age of civil servants (pensions paid by the Caisse de Retraite des Comores) could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCC minimum savings rate 2.5%; 28-day Treasury bills at 4.73% (banks only)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits after any tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCC minimum savings rate 2.5%; 28-day Treasury bills at 4.73% (banks only)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept at the 2.5% minimum savings rate, the only published deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BCC minimum savings rate 2.5%; 28-day Treasury bills at 4.73% (banks only)

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate 2.5%; global equity base 6% in euro terms; gold base 4.5%

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate 2.5%; global equity base 6% in euro terms; gold base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: deposits with some gold and foreign equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate 2.5%; global equity base 6% in euro terms; gold base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with foreign equity funds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provisions on dismissal or end-of-service indemnity could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: Civil servants are covered by the Caisse de Retraite des Comores, but no official source for the pension age, indexation or a scheme for private-sector workers was reachable.

savings_account.note: Banks must pay at least the BCC minimum rate of 2.5% on savings deposits.

fdr_3m.note: Banks take term deposits (the BCC counts term savings in money supply), but rates are not published.

fdr_1y.note: Banks take term deposits, but rates are not published.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Only 28-day Treasury bills are issued, by BCC auction to banks.

tbond_5y.note: No domestic government bond market was found.

tbond_10y.note: No domestic government bond market was found.

equity_fund.note: There is no stock exchange in the Comoros and no locally sold equity fund was found; investors can only use foreign funds.

gold.note: Gold is sold mainly as jewellery; the BCC publishes gold prices.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of the Comoros (Banque Centrale des Comores, BCC)

statistics.name: National Institute of Statistics and Economic and Demographic Studies (INSEED)
statistics.note: Linked from the BCC site; the site did not respond on 31 October 2026.
